summary: Frontend QA pass for atlas-core PR #7 port (Scrap Assist system, enemy taxonomy, defensive mechanics, Fox Statue) into Hyper Axel: Wrenchbound. Verified module wiring, HUD redesign, Q-key assist trigger, taxonomy in flight log, and controls overlay updates. No JS runtime errors. Deeper canvas-side verification (Flicker blink, Heavy armor 'shrugged it off' text, Fox Statue heal) limited by canvas opacity but code paths reviewed line-by-line.
passed_tests: Title -> PLAY -> START MISSION boots into Level 0 (Overgrown Outskirts) without errors
HUD top-bar Scrap Meter renders new design: 'SCRAP • GREEN' label visible with green fill, threshold tick marks present (verified via screenshot)
Pressing Q with empty meter does not crash the game (no page/console errors)
Killing a root_crawler produced flight log entry 'Defeated root_crawler [dinosaur]' — enemy taxonomy family suffix wired correctly
Pause menu CONTROLS overlay lists 'Q Scrap Assist (call-in)' and 'E Interact (Fox Statue)' (text-content verified in DOM)
ESC opens pause menu, CONTROLS opens overlay, ESC closes overlay back to pause (no regression)
TouchControls.js exposes new ASSIST button bound to KeyQ (code review)
Engine constructor initializes this.assists=[], assistUpgradeBonus=0, assistMalfunctionReduction=0; loadLevel resets this.assists=[]
Engine._update calls triggerScrapAssist(this) when input.assist is just-pressed; _update also runs assists.forEach(a=>a.update(dt)) and filters done; _render draws assists after player
Player attack vs enemies passes { smash: pl.smashing } in opts to e.takeDamage — heavy-armor smash bypass is wired
Pickup collision special-cases p.type === 'foxstatue' to require input.interact (E key) before collect()
Level 8 (Mirror Vault) levels.js confirms { type: 'foxstatue', x: 1100, y: 288 } entry
FoxStatuePickup class exists in pickups.js and is registered in createPickup factory
EnemyBase exposes isWeak()/isLarge()/takePercentDamage(); FlickerEnemy.update toggles flickerOpen every 0.95s; render() applies 0.32 alpha when sealed
EnemyBase.takeDamage early-returns with 'Flicker shell sealed!' toast when hasFlicker && !flickerOpen && !bypassFlicker
EnemyBase.takeDamage early-returns with 'Heavy shell shrugged it off!' toast when armored && !empowered (empowered = isGoldenGloves || isBurningBuffalo || opts.smash); +1 bonus damage when empowered
triggerScrapAssist() correctly tiers by ratio (<0.25 green, <0.50 yellow, <0.75 orange, else red), drains meter to 0, logs 'Scrap Assist: <TIER> call-in', and shows correct banner text per tier
SupplyDrop / GroundAssistActor / FighterPlaneAssist classes have .done flag and update/render methods compatible with engine assist loop
No JavaScript page errors and no console errors/warnings during the entire test session
not_deep_tested_due_to_canvas_limitation: Visual confirmation of parachute crate landing + heal/scrap reward (Green assist) - code path verified
Visual confirmation of GroundAssistActor charging in from left and striking (Yellow/Orange assists) - code path verified
Visual confirmation of FighterPlaneAssist flyby + bullets/bomb (Red assist) - code path verified
In-game verification of Heavy enemy 'shrugged it off' banner on Level 4 (requires reaching boss level)
In-game verification of Flicker 'shell sealed' banner on Level 2 with timed attack during dim phase
In-game verification of Fox Statue heal on Level 8 (requires beating 7 levels or NG+ entry)
Mobile touch ASSIST button click on actual touch device (button presence in JSX confirmed)
critical_code_review_comments: engine.js line 317: boss trigger reads this.currentLevel.boss?.triggerX — fine. New assist code is well isolated; no regressions to existing systems.

assists.js _doGreenAssist passes pl.y as groundY. If the player is mid-air when Q is pressed, the SupplyDrop will land at the player's current Y coordinate (not the actual ground). Minor visual oddity; consider casting to nearest platform top under pl.x for polish.

assists.js _doOrangeAssist malfunction calls pl.takeDamage(1, pl.x - 8, engine) — relies on player.takeDamage signature accepting (amount, fromX, engine). Verified Player class supports this (used elsewhere in collisions). OK.
enemies.js takePercentDamage uses bypassArmor & bypassFlicker — meaning Yellow/Orange assists damage Heavies and sealed Flickers. This matches PR #7 design (call-ins ignore both defenses).
hud.js _drawScrapMeter label color flips to dark (#0A0A0A) when meter > 20 — readable on green/yellow/orange fills but slightly low contrast on red fill. Cosmetic only.
engine.js Tab key for flight log uses this.input.just('Tab') — Input class preventDefault includes 'Tab' so browser focus is held. Good.
Fox Statue visual dimming after use depends on FoxStatuePickup internal state — visually unverifiable from DOM but code path present.
No file exceeds the 700-line guidance for new code (assists.js ~333 lines, focused). enemies.js ~378 lines, still acceptable; consider splitting per-enemy classes if more variants are added.
action_items: Optional polish: SupplyDrop should snap groundY to nearest platform top under player rather than using pl.y, so crate doesn't land mid-air if Q is pressed while jumping.
Optional polish: scrap meter label uses #0A0A0A on the RED tier fill — slightly lower contrast than other tiers; consider using #200000 or keeping white.

Recommend main agent perform a manual playthrough of Level 4 (Heavy shrugged-off banner), Level 2 (Flicker sealed banner), and Level 8 (Fox Statue heal) for visual confirmation. All code paths and wiring are verified clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 ports Scrap Assist + enemy defenses + Fox Statue from Godot PR #7. New module: /app/frontend/src/game/assists.js. Engine wires triggerScrapAssist on input.assist (KeyQ). HUD shows 'SCRAP • <TIER>' and '[Q] ASSIST' hint when meter>=20. Enemy flight log entries now include family in brackets, e.g. 'Defeated root_crawler [dinosaur]'. To trigger assists for testing: defeat 5-6 root_crawlers in level 0 to fill meter to ~25%+ (each enemy.scrapDrop * 8 added on death), then press Q. Confirmed no JS errors, HUD redesign visible, controls overlay updated, taxonomy in flight log working. Canvas-internal visual mechanics (Flicker alpha 0.32 dim, Heavy shrug banner, Fox Statue glow dim) are wired correctly per code review but cannot be DOM-asserted.
